answer: The fable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The quartz is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the crystal. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, burned when the recruit misbehaves. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
